name: Kubota Kanna
source:
Daughter of Kubota Shohei who taught her the skills of shrine carpentry. Interested in traditional techniques from young, her skills are on par with her father's.

Likes: Tradition, pro-wrestling
Dislikes: Wimpy peers
Hobbies: Carpentry, wrestling piledriver
